name: Barem
world_status: accessible description is silent on stress

earlier_scan.note: Pick 2020 (UH Manoa diss., read online) has a Barem phonology section but no stress statement, and says stress data for most N. Adelbert langs are 'minimal or nonexistent'.

sources.citation: Pick, Andrew. 2020. A Reconstruction of Proto-Northern Adelbert Phonology and Lexicon. PhD dissertation, University of Hawai'i at Manoa. 486 pp.
sources.note: Barem chapter 2.1 (pp. 42-70; 2.1.1 phonemes p. 45, 2.1.2 syllable and word structure pp. 50-54) describes phonemes, (C)(C)V(N)(C) syllables and word length but never mentions stress, tone, pitch or prominence for Barem. General 'Stress' section pp. 31-32: 'Suprasegmental phonology, including stress, has only been described for a small number of Northern Adelbert languages' (Mauwake, Pamosu, Usan) and 'the available data on stress in most languages are minimal or nonexistent'. Barem data = author's 2016-2019 fieldwork (Bunabun, Qkuan Kambuar dialects), Z'graggen 1980b, Capell 1952.

sources.citation: Pick, Andrew. 2019. Curriculum vitae (held by the project under dimi1244/)
sources.note: Lists a 'Barem Switch Reference' poster and 'Qkuan Kambuar pre-aspiration in synchrony and diachrony' (25th Manchester Phonology Meeting); no stress work.
Lists only Pick 2020 (pp. 188-194, subclassification) and Z'graggen 1971; alt. names Brem, Bububun, Bunabun, Bunu, Bunubun; no descriptive (grammar/phonology) reference.
21 lexical items from Pick (2019); no phonological notes.

sources.citation: Z'graggen, J. A. 1980b. A comparative word list of the Northern Adelbert Range languages, Madang Province, Papua New Guinea. Pacific Linguistics D-31. Canberra: ANU.
sources.note: Bunabun = E3; ~300-item wordlist. Intro sec. 7: transcription 'semi-phonemic'; p. vii notes Capell (1952:203ff) gives ~80 Bunabun words. No mention of stress; forms carry no stress marks.

sources.citation: Z'graggen, J. A. 1971. Classificatory and typological studies in languages of the Madang District. Pacific Linguistics C-19. Canberra: ANU.
sources.note: p. 6 (p. 14), whole-survey policy: 'The marking of stress has been omitted, since the stress patterning has not been well established yet.' Bunabun section 2.22.12.12 (pp. 44-45) gives villages, typological notes ([x] before /k/, no /l/, preposed negation) and says Capell (1952:193ff) 'provides a phoneme chart, notes on grammar and a wordlist'; nothing on stress.
Dialects Qkuan Kambuar, Kimbu Kambuar (extinct), Murukanam, Asumbin, Bunabun; ~1,200 speakers (2003); refs Ethnologue, Pick 2020, Pick 2019 ELAR deposit. Nothing on phonology.

sources.citation: Pick, Andrew. 2021/2022. A Reconstruction of Proto-Northern Adelbert Phonology and Lexicon. In Epps, Law & Pat-El (eds.), Historical Linguistics and Endangered Languages, 215-262. Routledge.
